# Sloty Frontend Copilot Instructions

Always read `AGENTS.md` before planning or making code changes.

Treat `AGENTS.md` as the frontend engineering source of truth for this repository.

When relevant, also read:

- `docs/business-analysis.txt`
- `docs/documentation.txt`
- `docs/sprints.txt`
- `docs/UI-refernce.txt`

This is the Angular frontend repository only.

Do not make backend, Django, database, migration, serializer, model, or API implementation changes here.

Prioritize:

- Arabic-first UI
- RTL-first layout
- Mobile-first screens
- Angular standalone components
- Typed API services
- Route guards
- Auth interceptor
- Clean feature structure
- Reusable shared components
- Vitest tests

After every code change, review whether `AGENTS.md` needs an update.

If no update is needed, state:

“AGENTS.md reviewed; no update needed.”
